sentences: Patient is a 53-year-old woman with low back pain for about two months.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Referred to physical therapy at the last visit.
Decreased sensation to light touch over the right L5 dermatome.
Straight leg raise is negative on both sides.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1040 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document at least six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
